# Standing Rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect Friday mornings** for LP calls and reading — no internal meetings.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **LP outreach goes through [Tom Restrepo](../people/tom-restrepo.md)** first; never contact an LP
  cold.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Screen every new deal against LP sector exclusions** — especially
  [Harold Weiss](../people/harold-weiss.md)'s defense/firearms exclusion — before briefing LPs.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never blindside a founder-CEO** on an exit; brief them before the market (see
  [Michael Devlin](../people/michael-devlin.md)).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **No deal detail outward without Kate's OK** — draft, don't send.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Discipline over pace:** don't chase deployment; walk from a broken diligence story.
